name: Nam Cheong Limited
summary: Established in 1968 and headquartered in Singapore, Nam Cheong Limited operates as an investment holding company primarily focused on marine vessel construction and leasing. Its shipbuilding division manufactures a diverse array of specialized craft, including anchor handling tug supply (AHTS) vessels, platform supply vessels (PSVs), maintenance work vessels (MWV), accommodation work barges (AWB), safety standby vessels (SSVs), landing crafts, and fast crew boats (FCB). Beyond manufacturing, the firm also provides vessel chartering, ship delivery services, and undertakes various trading activities. Nam Cheong's main clientele consists of major oil corporations, oil field service providers, ship owners, and marine service operators. The company maintains an extensive international footprint, with operations spanning Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam, the People's Republic of China, the Netherlands, India, Tunisia, the Middle East, the United States, West Africa, and Latin America.
